tagline: A clearer view of what’s nearby
demoNote: Fictional incidents for product preview. These are not real reports.
searchCityOnly: Search supports 11 Ukrainian cities. Street search is not available yet.
invalidDates: Choose a valid date range of no more than 366 days.
densityNote: Density of reported incidents, not a measure of danger.
noPrevious: No incidents in the previous period
noResults: No reported incidents in this area for the selected period.
offline: You’re offline. Showing previously loaded data where available.
locationDenied: Location unavailable. You can keep exploring the map.
shareFailed: Unable to share. Copy the page address instead.
coverage: Public reporting does not cover every incident. Coverage varies by region, source and period.
listHint: Accessible list of incidents in the visible area
mapError: The basemap could not load. Check your connection or retry.
mapUnavailable: Interactive map unavailable. The incident list and filters remain available.
installIos: On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen
mapLabel: Map of reported incidents in Ukraine
dateFilterNote: For records with no event date, filters use reported or publication date.
eventFilterNote: Only reports with an established event date are included. Dates without a time use the Ukrainian calendar day. Coverage is partial.
publicationFilterNote: Shows reports published during this period, including older events or events with an unknown date.
eventDateInferred: Event date derived from the source’s wording and publication date.
liveCoverage: Police and media reports, plus archived court records. Partial coverage; markers show settlement centres.
cityCentre: Centre of the mentioned city — the incident site is unknown
sourceArchived: Archived source. Historical reports remain on the map; collection has stopped.
